text:
Maya Patel: Need a clear handoff protocol for partner SEVs that touches marketplace listing controls and SI uploads. Proposal: create a shared channel, pin a 1-page runbook, and use an Ops Bot command to create + annotate incidents.

Owen Chen: Sounds good. Minimal friction is key. Can Ops Bot also set a 'listing-freeze' tag so Product pauses pushes? cc @Redwood Ops Bot.

Redwood Ops Bot: Yes. Example commands:
`/partner-incident create --partner=lattice --sev=sev1 --include-si=true`
`/partner-incident tag --listing-freeze=on`
Bot will post oncall roster + a starter checklist when channel created.

Samir Rao: We should standardize mappings: partner sev1 -> Redwood P1 (customer-down), partner sev2 -> Redwood P2 (degraded). SI urgent when customer-facing -> escalate to P1.

Jill (SI Lead): SI needs scoped upload access to post sanitized traces. Can we set retention to 48h and limit exposure?

Tessa L: Yes. We'll provision a partner service account with 48h artifact retention. RBAC notes and retention will be in the pinned runbook. Also include who can trigger listing pause.

Ben (Lattice Eng): We'll provide 24/7 coverage for true P1s. Our expectation: handback only after mitigation and assignment of a postmortem owner (within 4h). Need an ack flow on handbacks.

Owen Chen: Handback flow idea: the handback message must include mitigation summary + next check-in ETA. Recipient must react :white_check_mark: within 30m or it escalates to the oncall lead. We'll add that to the runbook template.

Maya Patel: Plan: I'll create #partner-lattice-sev-ref and invite Lattice + SI. Dry-run Friday 09:30 PT to exercise channel creation, bot commands, RBAC uploads, and handback ACK flow.

Samir Rao: I'll post a one-page checklist with triage fields and the 6-point incident template before the drill: triage summary, owners, actions, listing flag, rollback trigger, postmortem owner.

Jill (SI Lead): I'll confirm SI rotation and which contacts can trigger listing freeze before the dry-run.

Tessa L: I'll add marketplace notification automation so Product gets pinged on SEV open.

Owen Chen: Action items recap: Maya create channel + invites (today), Samir checklist (EOD), Owen wire Ops Bot commands & ack escalation (tomorrow), Tessa RBAC + retention docs, Jill confirm SI rotation, Ben confirm handback SLA. Dry-run Friday 09:30 PT.

Redwood Ops Bot: Reminder scheduled -> dry-run Friday 09:00 PT. I will post the agenda and automation checklist in the channel at 09:10 PT. :robot_face:
